contract: The parent editorial workflow combines the source-grounded 80-check registry, canonical context and continuity evidence, configured-provider checks and explicit editorial controls. Findings pin immutable manuscript artifacts and Unicode offsets; every repair is a reviewed immutable candidate whose apply and undo use canonical work revisions without rewriting sibling issues or accepted evidence.
acceptance: Run deterministic and contextual checks over canonical saved manuscript coverage with completed, skipped and externally unavailable states rather than fabricated findings.
Retain exact finding quote offsets, source draft and artifact versions across later source revisions; stale findings remain inspectable but cannot be repaired.

Prepare a reviewed anchored repair without changing prose, apply it through canonical promotion, and undo through canonical revision restoration while preserving unrelated text and sibling issue drafts.

Preserve accepted continuity evidence against its immutable source: applying a replacement marks it stale, undoing to the original draft makes it current again, and historical editorial provenance remains immutable.
Exercise configured-model checks, custom checks, judge, reader panel and comparative ranking with successful bounded typed outputs and exact real-manuscript anchors.
remaining_limits: No configured external reasoning model was available in isolated qualification. Successful model editorial checks, custom checks, judge, reader-panel and comparative-rank execution therefore remains unqualified; unavailable outcomes are recorded honestly and no provider response is faked.
Deterministic scanners and model findings are editorial signals for human review, not objective proof of literary quality.
The parent remains in progress until the successful configured-model acceptance is exercised with real credentials and bounded typed anchored output.
